preview.what: Vue reactivity: ref, reactive, computed, watch — and their traps.
preview.picture: A spreadsheet: change a cell (ref) and dependent cells (computed) update themselves. Watchers are someone standing by to react when a cell changes.
preview.why: Losing reactivity by destructuring is the classic Vue screen question.
preview.bn: Spreadsheet: একটা cell (ref) বদলালে নির্ভরশীল cell (computed) নিজে বদলায়; watcher = পাশে দাঁড়ানো লোক।
